title: Choose the visual world (bolder hand)
question: Bolder re-roll. The deal leads with Living Skin. Keep it, take the alternate, go standard, or re-roll again.

options.label: Living Skin
options.thesis: The page as a living skin: pale mantle ground, red-brown pigment cells that expand under the pointer, one blue-green flash for the active signal.
options.viewport: A huge brown headline at left, and a field of pigment cells at right that expand and travel as waves under the pointer: the one 3D/shader moment.
options.risk: Abstract: recruiters may not read 'cuttlefish', and cream grounds sit near the AI default unless the pigment work is genuinely alive.

raised.raise: Every project and role carries a ruled code line beneath it (year, kind, stack), like a catalogue stock code.
The one blue-green is owned outright: links, active nav, focus and the primary action, nothing else.

options.label: Marbled sheets
options.thesis: Each section is one lifted sheet of marbled paper: light, quiet ground, and a pigment pattern combed by the pointer in the hero only.
options.viewport: A framed paper sheet with the headline at left and a live marbling field at right that you comb with the cursor; 'Sheet 01 of 08' at its foot.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: sections become separate sheets, which is exactly the division you asked for. It loses narrowly on audience identification.
options.risk: Two pigments must stay subtle, or it turns into a craft-fair look.

options.label: Toy catalogue
options.kept: A ruled code line under each item.

options.label: Phosphor terminal
options.risk: Dark, and the most common developer-portfolio trope.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white developer portfolio, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, image block right, blue button.
